"import cadquery as cq

# Hard-coded parameters (mm)
PLATE_X = 110.0   # X extent of base plate
PLATE_Y = 70.0    # Y extent of base plate
PLATE_T = 12.0    # plate thickness (z from 0 to 12)

BOSS_D = 40.0     # boss diameter
BOSS_H = 25.0     # boss height above plate top (boss top at z = 12 + 25 = 37)

HOLE_D = 9.0      # through-hole diameter
HOLE_XY = [(41.0, 21.0), (41.0, -21.0), (-41.0, 21.0), (-41.0, -21.0)]

# Base plate: centered in XY, base face at z = 0
plate = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(PLATE_X, PLATE_Y, PLATE_T, centered=(True, True, False))
)

# Cylindrical boss on top face of plate, axis along Z at plate center
boss = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=PLATE_T)
    .circle(BOSS_D / 2.0)
    .extrude(BOSS_H)
)

# Union into a single solid
part = plate.union(boss)

# Four through holes, axes parallel to Z, through plate thickness only (z = 0..12)
holes = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .pushPoints(HOLE_XY)
    .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0)
    .extrude(PLATE_T)
)
part = part.cut(holes)

# Ensure single solid
solid = part.val()
assert isinstance(solid, cq.Solid) or (hasattr(solid, "ShapeType") and solid.ShapeType() == "Solid")

# Export to STEP in the current working directory
cq.exporters.export(part, "part.step")

# Optional sanity check (deterministic)
bb = solid.BoundingBox()
print("volume =", solid.Volume())
print("bbox   =", bb.xlen, bb.ylen, bb.zlen)"
